expansion.line2: Further phases: schedule to be confirmed

power.title: Power
power.text: Energy at the centre of the plan.
power.more: An existing 215 MW substation anchors the first phase, with a staged upgrade path of up to 1 GW as the cluster grows.

scale.title: Scale
scale.text: Land and capacity for phased growth.
scale.more: 191.8 hectares allocated for phase one and approximately 1,300 hectares reserved for the cluster’s future expansion.

location.title: Location
location.text: A Eurasian base for global compute.
location.more: An industrial location in Ekibastuz, Kazakhstan, between Europe and Asia — with the space to grow in phases.

connectivity.title: Connectivity
connectivity.more: Power, land and partners planned together as one ecosystem, so new capacity connects to where it is needed.

flexibility.title: Flexibility
flexibility.text: Multiple ways to build and operate.
flexibility.more: Wholesale colocation, build-to-suit, greenfield development or AI compute partnerships — the model adapts to each partner.

partnership.title: Partnership
partnership.more: Public and private stakeholders working to one plan — from land and energy to long-term development of the cluster.

horizon.title: Horizon
horizon.more: Phase one with 50 MW is planned for commissioning in Q2 2027; further phases follow as the cluster develops.
